scams.description: Fake pop-ups claiming your computer has a virus and prompting you to call an unauthorized support number.
red_flags: Requests payment via gift cards or crypto
scams.safe_action: Close your browser immediately and do not call the number.

scams.description: Imposter scams involving someone posing as a family member or law enforcement demanding immediate wire transfers.
red_flags: Demands immediate wire transfer or gift cards
scams.safe_action: Hang up and call your family member directly on their known phone number.

scams.description: Threats of legal arrest or benefit suspension unless immediate payment is submitted.
red_flags: Asks for SSN or bank info
scams.safe_action: Hang up. Government agencies never demand immediate payment over the phone or via gift cards.
